integrator_review.review_actor: AI technical source reconciliation with targeted cross-checks; not a new human vote or independent human validation
integrator_review.why_no_new_author_case: All newly identified issues can be resolved by the ratified scope rules and original content, or remain explicit documentary unknowns. Missing respondent data, unavailable arm allocation bridges, pooled controls and uncertain death causes are not questions that author ratification can turn into facts.

resolved_technical_issues.issue: Historical pooled-control witness versus the exact original-arm target
resolved_technical_issues.disposition: The STEP6 historical complete mortality label is preserved as historical, while its underlying three-group pooled-placebo proof is retained as supporting information. The primary report explicitly describes four randomized arms and the SAP explicitly prespecifies pooling the two placebo arms. That proof does not supply each original placebo denominator; the current exact original-arm cell therefore remains unknown. This is a source-scope correction under the retained arm-specific rule, not a new human vote or erasure of the earlier source-group result.
resolved_technical_issues.provenance: STEP6 primary PDF1 describes allocation4:1:2:1; SAP PDF15/printed13 explicitly describes two randomized placebo arms pooled in analyses. Root checked both against the historical R0/B3 proof record.

resolved_technical_issues.disposition: Detailed end-of-trial tables distinguish item respondents and phase-specific subsets. Maintenance initial-phase ideation and actual attempt have an all-SAS witness; its completed-suicide placebo item has one missing respondent. Diabetes and Obesity respondent subsets are not relabeled as their full nominal SAS. Follow-up subsets are not extended to the original full population.
resolved_technical_issues.provenance: SCALE CSR Maintenance PDF989-990; Diabetes PDF1701/1703; Obesity PDF3525; targeted cross-check QA_SCALE_JUDGMENTS.json.

resolved_technical_issues.issue: An originally unknown cause assigned cardiovascular by charter
resolved_technical_issues.disposition: The Obesity report's explicit uncertainty is preserved. A charter cardiovascular classification is not substituted for proof that the unresolved death was nonsuicidal.

Remaining unknowns are closed scientific dispositions and do not imply missing author forms.
